Name: Hananiah, Sealer of the Covenant
Summary: Hananiah was among the chiefs who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's day, listed with Hosea, Hashub, and others. NOTE ON IDENTITY: the text does not say whether this Hananiah is any other Hananiah in the text, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 10:23 sealer and does not merge him with any other Hananiah.
LifeLesson: A sealed covenant is a promise put in writing.
